name: project.scaffold_one_page_app
description: Scaffold a polished one-page React + Node project inside an allowed workspace folder from high-level page details. Use for portfolio, landing, business card, product, or tech one-pager requests.

args_schema.path: target project folder relative to current workspace or absolute path inside allowed roots
args_schema.owner_name: person, brand, or project name to feature
args_schema.theme: visual style, for example developer tech dark
args_schema.project_summary: what the page should say about the person/project/work
args_schema.include_backend: true to include a minimal Node/Express backend
args_schema.overwrite: true to overwrite files that already exist
